onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to TANK Wallet
onboarding.welcome.subtitle: The most secure hot wallet on the market. Multi-chain native, security by default, zero trust in contracts.
onboarding.welcome.disclaimer: Your keys are generated locally with BIP-39, BIP-32, BIP-44 and SLIP-0010. The mnemonic is encrypted with AES-256-GCM and never leaves your device.
onboarding.generate.title: Your seed phrase
onboarding.generate.warning: Write down these 12 words on paper and store them in a safe place. They are the ONLY way to recover your wallet. Never type them on websites, never photograph them, never store them in the cloud.
onboarding.generate.continue: I have written it all down, continue
onboarding.confirm.title: Confirm your seed
onboarding.confirm.description: Type each word in the correct order to confirm you have written everything down.

onboarding.password.title: Encryption password
onboarding.password.description: This password encrypts your mnemonic locally with AES-256-GCM (PBKDF2 with 250k iterations). It cannot be recovered — if forgotten, you will need to import the seed again.
